language.title: Language
language.description: Choose the language used throughout the interface. Your choice is remembered on this device.

checklist.title: Getting started
checklist.hidden: The checklist is hidden for everyone in this workspace.
checklist.footer: The checklist floats at the bottom right of every page until every item is done.

checklist.hiddenToast: Setup checklist hidden. Show it again in Settings.

importApp.title: Import an app
importApp.description: Search the store by name or paste its URL. The listing, the keywords and the first positions arrive within minutes.

secondMarket.title: Track keywords in a second market
secondMarket.description: Rankings differ by storefront. Track your keywords in another market to see where you stand there.

addCompetitor.title: Add a competitor
addCompetitor.description: See your positions next to an app you compete with, on every keyword you track.

connectConsole.title: Connect a store console
connectConsole.description: Connect App Store Connect or the Google Play Console to see listing visits and downloads beside your rankings.

connectAiClient.title: Connect your AI client
connectAiClient.description: Create a personal token and use it from Claude, Cursor or another MCP client.

turnOnAlert.title: Turn on an alert
turnOnAlert.description: Get an email or a webhook when something changes in your rankings, your listing or your reviews.

replyToReview.title: Reply to a review
replyToReview.description: Write a reply or let AI draft one, keep it and post it from the reviews page.

fillKeywordField.title: Fill your keyword field
fillKeywordField.description: Write the private 100 character iOS keyword field and see which tracked keywords it covers.

improveRankings.label: Improve my rankings
improveRankings.description: Fill the keyword field, add competitors and watch your positions move.

researchIdea.label: Research an idea
researchIdea.description: Compare competitors and markets before you commit to keywords.

useWithAi.label: Use AsoBeast from my AI
useWithAi.description: Connect an MCP client and let your agent read your data.

secondMarket.quotes: Search a keyword exactly by putting it in quotes
secondMarket.pasteList: Paste a comma or newline list into Add keywords
secondMarket.searchWords: See how many words each market's search reads
secondMarket.score: Open a score to see where its popularity came from and how sure it is

addCompetitor.rating: Competitor cards show each app's rating, rating count and version

connectAiClient.usage: See when each token was last used and how many requests it made

turnOnAlert.events: Choose from {count, number} typed webhook events, rank gains included
turnOnAlert.retire: Keywords that cost requests and never rank come back as actions to retire them

replyToReview.language: Drafts are written in the language of the review

fillKeywordField.localization: Add a localization your app ships to get more keyword field characters
fillKeywordField.limits: Check every field against the store's limits and guidelines
fillKeywordField.newest: Pick from the newest App Store localizations, including Bangla, Tamil, Telugu and Urdu
fillKeywordField.words: Chinese, Japanese and Thai keywords are split into words
